class_academic_year.name: class_academic_year
class_academic_year.value: length("class"."academic_year") = 9 AND "class"."academic_year" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' AND CAST(substr("class"."academic_year", 6, 4) AS INTEGER) = CAST(substr("class"."academic_year", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 1

purged_year_archived.name: purged_year_archived
purged_year_archived.value: "academic_year_lifecycle"."purged_at" IS NULL OR "academic_year_lifecycle"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL
